title: Disproof of a Conjectured Upper Bound for the Davenport Constant
summary: Let $G= C_{n_1}\oplus\cdots\oplus C_{n_r}$ be a finite abelian group with $1<n_1\mid\cdots\mid n_r$, and let $\rr(G)=r$ denote its rank. The Davenport constant $\DD(G)$ is the least integer $\ell$ such that every sequence of $\ell$ elements of $G$ contains a nonempty zero-sum subsequence, and $\DD^*(G)=1+\sum_{i=1}^r(n_i-1)$ is its classical lower bound. A long-standing conjecture asserts that $\DD(G)\le\DD^*(G)+\rr(G)-1$. In this paper, we disprove this conjecture.
